title: Across Practice/PCP
one_line_definition: This table summarizes risk adjustment gap activity across practices and their individual PCPs, showing the volume of HCC coding opportunities that have been prioritized for outreach or closure.
result_meaning: Analysts and care managers use this table to identify which practices and PCPs carry the highest volume of actionable coding gaps, enabling targeted intervention prioritization and workload distribution.

Targeted gaps.definition: The count of HCC coding gaps that have been specifically flagged and prioritized for a PCP or practice to address within the current measurement period.
Targeted gaps.increasing: Rising values indicate that more suspected or unrecaptured HCC conditions are being identified and queued for clinical review, reflecting either a growing at-risk population or more aggressive gap identification efforts.
Targeted gaps.decreasing: Falling values suggest that fewer new gaps are being surfaced, which may reflect successful gap closure reducing the open queue, a shrinking attributed population, or reduced completeness in gap identification workflows.
